messages.subject: Problems with covariates in "cp" models.
parts:
Good evening, 
I write because I have problems in inserting the covariates into my model. Before I insert the covariates in the model, I already correct for the missing values, however when then I run the model, for each covariate I get this error message: 

"Warning in input_eval.bru_input(component[[part]$input, data, env = component$env,  :
  Model input 'cov3' for 'cov3' returned some NA values.
Attempting to fill in spatially by nearest available value." 

I guess I’m doing something wrong, but I can’t figure out what because in my raster there are no NA. 

Here my code:

### coastal_coniferous_woodland_freshwater_saltwater
cov3 = coastal_coniferous_woodland_freshwater_saltwater1
values = values(cov3)
cov3_val = values

cov3_SPDF = terra::rast(SpatialPixelsDataFrame(points = coordinates(cov3),
                                                data = data.frame(cov3 = values),
                                                proj4string = inla.sp_get_crs(mainland)))

values <- inlabru:::eval_spatial(data = cov3_SPDF,
                                 where = ips)

ips_sf <- fm_transform(ips,
                       crs = fm_crs(cov3_SPDF))

values2 <- bru_fill_missing(data = cov3_SPDF,
                            where = ips,
                            values = values)

cov3_SPDF = SpatialPixelsDataFrame(points = new_xy,
                                   data = data.frame(cov3 = as.vector(A%*% values2)),
                                   proj4string = inla.sp_get_crs(mainland))

cov3 = terra::rast(cov3_SPDF)

sum(is.na(cov3))
